# Playbook: compare
Use when: list files changed between two commits

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id)" |
| repository | the user: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` or a workspace repository link id | STOP. Say: "Which repository? (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> or link id)" |
| base | a full 40-character SHA from the user, or "index" (the commit of the active code index) | "index" |
| head | a full 40-character SHA from the user, or "branch" (the current head of the link's branch) | "branch" |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was compared."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Comparing commits needs an LPM API key; this connector cannot do it."
2. IF <input:base> is neither "index" nor 40 hexadecimal characters → STOP. Say: "I need full 40-character SHAs; a short SHA cannot be compared. Which base commit?"
   IF <input:head> is neither "branch" nor 40 hexadecimal characters → STOP. Say: "I need full 40-character SHAs; a short SHA cannot be compared. Which head commit?"
3. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active workspace link; only workspace links can be compared (project link ids fail)."
4. CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   SAVE: indexCommit = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (empty when pointer is null); base = <saved:indexCommit> when <input:base> == "index", else <input:base>; head = <input:head>
   IF <saved:base> is empty → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> has no active code index, so there is no index commit. Which base commit? (40 characters)"
   IF <input:head> != "branch" → go to step 6.
5. CALL `preview_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   SAVE: head = result.commitSha
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (empty when pointer is null) != <saved:indexCommit> → STOP. Say: "The active index of <saved:url> changed meanwhile. Run this playbook again."
6. CALL `compare_repository_commits` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","baseCommitSha":"<saved:base>","headCommitSha":"<saved:head>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "could not be resolved" → STOP. Say: "GitHub does not know one of the commits <saved:base> / <saved:head> in <saved:url>, or LPM has no GitHub access to it (GitHub App or the link creator's credential)."
   SAVE: relation, aheadBy, behindBy, truncated = result.status, result.aheadBy, result.behindBy, result.truncated; files = one "<path> (<status>, +<additions> -<deletions>)" per item of result.files
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (empty when pointer is null) != <saved:indexCommit> → STOP. Say: "The active index of <saved:url> changed during the comparison. Run this playbook again."

relation: ahead | behind | identical | diverged. Never claim a file list that step 6 did not return; it has names and line counts only, no code.
